scope: direct observed nonterminal BO3 singles score/server snapshots from a fixed known ATP/WTA regular grass-event family; engineering targets from same publisher rules-complete terminal scores
grouping: publisher match_id appears in one scheduled UTC chronological split; all captures must stay in that split; no random row or point split

rules_family.selector: Exact tournament name in the declared tour allowlist and matching ATP/WTA round prefix, explicit best_of=BO3, distinct joined player IDs with nonempty unpaired player names. No numeric tier-key mapping or terminal-score-derived formats.
rules_family.format: standard advantage games, six-game sets, seven-point win-by-two set tiebreaks in every set including third

sources.document: 2026 ATP Rulebook, I.1.02.B singles match format
sources.summary: ATP Tour singles use three standard tiebreak sets.
Regular WTA singles, main draw and qualifying, use three standard tiebreak sets and ITF rules.
The six declared ATP cities are regular June grass events.

sources.document: official 2026 WTA calendar, retrieved 2026-10-09 (mutable calendar now dated October 2)
sources.summary: The six declared WTA cities are regular June grass events; this identifies families only and is not a timestamped match-specific format declaration.
ITF qualifying and exceptional formats vary; all ITF/unknown families excluded.

rules_family.limitation: Publisher metadata is a static released match index, not archived pre-match declaration; ordinary official format is attached from event identity without using outcomes. Match-specific alternative-format notices are absent; contradictory or unknown rules are excluded, and no independent rules audit is claimed.

eligibility: Complete publisher match index with empty retirement/walkover event_status; BO5, unknown formats, doubles including slash-paired player names, missing players and unknown rules family excluded.
All timestamps valid, nondecreasing and inside the original scheduled match split; interleaved groups or score-tape size over 8192 rows rejected as import errors.

End-of-tape sets and completed-game arrays must describe exactly one normal rules-complete BO3 winner, with no earlier set prefix already match-complete. Terminal display cleanup is not a forecast input.

Nonterminal rows independently map to valid standard MatchState using directly observed sets, completed/current games, point display, tiebreak flag and current server. Unknown server, malformed scores and ambiguous scores excluded at row level.

Completed set prefixes and in-set games must never reverse/change across valid captures. A conflicting score at the same timestamp rejects the group. Invalid rows cannot repair or authorize a transition.
Remove globally repeated identical score/server states within each match, retaining first causal occurrence; exclude terminal and postterminal rows.
Polling gaps accepted as unknown missing points. Never infer a point winner, serve count, historical first server outside a current tiebreak, or any hidden point sequence.
bounded_selection: All 5380 groups audited; among eligible groups in each split select earliest scheduled UTC then lexicographic match_id, cap60 per split; publish per-group exclusions and all coverage counts.
features: Only directly observed state and explicit prematch nominal BO3 plus externally documented event-family rules. Completed sets already observed at capture are valid score features. Future/final sets, terminal winner, ratings, future server and match aggregates excluded.
raw_model: Existing src/prediction/tennis.py TennisWinProbability fresh explicit Beta(2,2) neutral serve prior, zero observed point updates for every snapshot. Same unmodified rules engine.
primary_baseline: Same neutral score-only TennisWinProbability with Beta(2,2) and zero updates; raw model must be identical and its paired improvement exactly zero.
secondary_baseline: Unconditional match-winner probability0.5, descriptive only; no quality or release gate.

calibration.method: logistic(a + b*logit(raw_probability)); a intercept, b slope
calibration.training_split: development only; equal total weight per match divided among its unique snapshots
calibration.objective: mean equally match-weighted Bernoulli log loss + lambda/2*(a*a+(b-1)*(b-1))
calibration.optimizer: scipy.optimize.minimize L-BFGS-B with analytic gradient; maxiter100, ftol1e-12, gtol1e-9; failed/nonfinite fit means no calibrated metrics
calibration.parameter_selection: No tuning/threshold selection from development metrics, calibration or test. Fit once using declared objective. Calibration split only separately assessed; never refit after its metrics.
calibration.status: Private publisher engineering calibration only; independent qualification remains absent.

metric_weighting: Each match equal total weight; unique snapshots divide that match weight.
metrics: fixed10-bin reliability with match and snapshot counts
paired deltas against same neutral score-only baseline

uncertainty.rule: No intervals with fewer than2 match groups; bootstrap freezes fitted development parameters and does not account for calibration training uncertainty.

execution_order: Freeze protocol; complete coverage import without forecasts; focused synthetic causal tests; development forecasts/fit and immutable fit receipt; calibration/test with unchanged imported selection and stored development parameters. Never edit protocol after metrics.
release_gate: No promotion or public accuracy claim. Same-publisher terminal targets, sampling exclusions and static metadata cannot qualify human-reviewed independent outcomes, camera pipelines, calibration or production.
amendment_reason: Conditional v2 suffix point transitions rejected polling gaps and did not join doubles names. V3 evaluates directly observed states without invented points, freezes a known event-family rule selector and development-only regularized calibration before metrics.
